name: Gravity
description: A steady pull. The arrow shows which way.
_help: Shmup and racer. Racer: pull is a share of gravity, and the arrow points down (heavier: lower, shorter jumps) or up (lighter: floatier); level 1 is always down. Shmup: pull: px/s the ship is dragged toward the arrow; the same at every level, and well under the ship's speed so you can always fly against it (npm run check:shmup checks this). shiftEvery: seconds between direction swaps; 0 = never (level 1). The arrow blinks for the last second before a swap. levels: settings for level 2 and 3, picked at the machine.
